text:
sophie: Quick heads-up: AV flagged that the room recorder overlaps with the roadmap demo at 11:20. Thinking we shift roadmap earlier by 10 mins. Thoughts?
ops-bot: Recording scheduled: all-hands-2026-03-25-roomA (start 11:15 UTC) :information_source:
matt: @sophie okay to shift, but need final sign-off from execs. I'll ping @ceo.
ada: Captions team — if we shift, we need ~10 extra mins to re-sync captions. Can we get a 5-min buffer at start?
james: AV can route backup mic. Command to flip to backup: `./avctl route --src podium2 --dst recorder`
nina: OBS: main scene shows dropped frames in last test. log snippet: `ERR_DROP frames=34 scene=AllHands_Main` — recommending switching to AllHands_LowRes for recording.
ops-bot: Deploy check: RTMP health ok for region-eu. Latency 180ms.
matt: Can we also record a separate local backup on the laptop? @sophie please confirm with presenter.
sophie: I'll confirm. For agenda, I'll move roadmap to 11:10 and call the demo 11:18. Will post updated agenda in 2m.
ada: :thumbsup: Planning to delay captions by 2m to sync.
james: I'll run the route command once sophie confirms. Patch tested on staging.
nina: Switching OBS scene to AllHands_LowRes in 30s on test machine.
devex: Also adding a line to the runbook: if recorder conflicts, use backup route and low-res scene. PR: https://git.internal/repo/123
sophie: Confirmed. Agenda updated: roadmap 11:10, demo 11:18. Thanks everyone — see you in 10.
